annotation.speech2: Two pictures of the same blue sinusoidal wave use the same horizontal scale. In the upper picture the orange boat is at a rising mean-level crossing at x sub b equals two, with a green crest at x sub c equals four. In the lower picture the orange boat is at the crest, so both coordinates equal four, and a purple amplitude arrow measures the larger height. The first picture has a steep local profile at the boat and the second has a horizontal tangent.
